observations: Closed roots and nested representations correspond to the reviewed logical profiles. Projection fields contain no private metadata; extraction map keeps source/projection/profile associations private and reuses the existing source reference and identifier/hash shapes.

Projection-byte and profile digests remain distinct from source document_sha256. No containing-map/bundle self-hash field or manifest digest cycle is introduced; registration and exact-byte correspondence remain semantic obligations.

Text selectors allow only concrete ASCII canonical zero-based section/unit indices, exact permitted suffixes and strict termination. Wildcards, signs, leading zeroes, Unicode digits, extra suffixes and newline/control tails are rejected. Syntax alone does not enforce in-range selection or profile authority.

Array shape ceilings reuse 1024 locally and intentionally cannot enforce aggregate inventory, key uniqueness, complete mapping or context/source integrity. Context cycles, dangling keys and over-eight stored groups remain admissible representations, requiring later bounded resolution/refusal.

Tests exercise explicit logical field/type/closure and boundary requirements with synthetic fixtures; deliberate unsafe/semantically incomplete acceptance demonstrates limits rather than claiming runtime safety. Raw parser, nonblank/scalar validity, encoded bytes, privacy exclusions and claim support remain outside shape validation.

Logical DATA/PUBLICATION profile bodies are preserved relative to the earlier review; only intervening scoped receipt-reference/status paragraphs differ. Their previous review scope is accurately limited.
